integrity: The package includes all reproducibility code for the finite check; independent audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers n>=5 and 1<=k<=n; Conjecture 2.7(ii) and k>n are not addressed. The n>=300 proof depends on the published Brun–Titchmarsh and Rosser–Schoenfeld inequalities; a bounded exact checker verifies n=5,...,299. Historical originality remains exposed to unindexed equivalent earlier results.
title: Prime-counting root monotonicity: Sun’s Conjecture 2.7(i)
